items.title: Arista patches new VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day exploited in attacks
items.excerpt: Arista Networks released security updates to patch an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability affecting VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) On-Prem deployments. [facts: actively exploited]

items.title: Arista Warns of Critical VeloCloud SQL Injection Zero-Day Exploited in Attacks
items.excerpt: Attackers are exploiting a zero-day SQL injection flaw in Arista's VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO), the central management system for VeloCloud SD-WAN networks, the company said in an advisory on Octobe… [facts: October 22; 22]
